chunks: We will certainly put iron collars on their necks which will reach up to their chins, so they will have their heads raised.
ai.seo_question: What does the phrase 'aghlaalan fahiya ila al-adqan' mean in Surah Yaseen?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often interpreted as a metaphor for the self-imposed spiritual blindness of disbelievers, where their own denial acts as the 'shackle' preventing them from seeing the truth. The term 'muqmahoon' (heads raised high) signifies not just physical restraint but a state of arrogant humiliation, as they are forced to face their Lord with necks extended in submission despite their pride. This imagery underscores the concept of 'asbab al-hujjah' (means of proof), where the disbelievers' own choices become the instruments of their eternal punishment.
